ValidationRule.description: Event cannot go to the next status unless the previous one is the directly previous status (eg. cannot go from inquiry to confirmed) no going back to another status
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Corporate_Event', OR( AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Inquiry')) ), AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled')), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Inquiry'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Proposal Sent'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Proposal Sent'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Confirmed'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Confirmed'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'In Planning'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'In Planning'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Executing'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Executing'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Completed'), TRUE), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Cancelled'), TRUE) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status transition. Events must follow the sequence: Inquiry → Proposal Sent → Confirmed → In Planning → Executing → Completed. No skipping or reverting is allowed. To exit, set status to Cancelled.
